reports.desc: I made my order and they shipped it through an illegitimate shipping company and the delivery driver stole it. I don’t have issues in my building with stolen packages and i check for the package literal SECONDS after i got the delivered notification. They staged the delivery and used a fake label on the lobby door instead of bringing it to my actual door. I filed a a complaint for investigation with the shipping company and they never contacted me back. So i contacted Micas and asked for my money back and they sent me to the another illegitimate company that i apparently paid for shipping protection and they’re also giving me the run around. Micas is saying there’s nothing they can do and it’s a total loss.

Someone named Ayana called my mother leaving a voicemail that she forwarded to me. The voicemail stated that I owed a debt and would be served court papers to my job. I called the number back and a man answered, I gave him a case number that was given from the voicemail left on my mother's mobile. He asked me to confirm my birthdate, which he already knew. I asked what is this about and he would not tell me unless I verified my date of birth. He immediately got loud with me and told me he would see me in court and hung up! I called back and the same guy answered and I told him don't my family ever again.

I redeem 200,000 seats through noom app September 14 and I never received my $50 gift card when I called them they sent me term and condition I redeem earlier for $20 gift card that sent me that but $50. It’s not working nowhere in that app said you can’t redeem 200,000 seats. I work so hard for that and I need my $50 gift card.

The individual contacted me through indeed, which is a job posting site.  He stated that he represented mentis systems and has a temporary assignment through the nestle corporation.  I decided to check mentis systems website. It lists all the locations that are foreign and domestic.  For the united states locations, they have different addresses but the same corporate phone number.  I tried to call the number but no one answered.  I didn't try to contact the foreign locations.  So I'm skeptical of the intentions for the business.

An email was circulated on a neighborhood listserve advertising discounted dryer vent service on a certain day if enough neighbors signed up. It turns out it's a known scam technique. Someone came and did remove some dryer lint, but vastly overcharged for the service. On investigation the website is entirely fake and AI created and the address location is a dumpster in a strip mall in the suburbs.

Bob Applequist contacted me via Linked as a representative/Founder of WMS & Assoicates LLC to help me secure interviews and job offers (Attached signed agreement).  Bob introduced me to one person but never schedule or secured formal interviews ove the course of 9 1/2 months.  I have attached the signed agreement.  I recently found out via the IL Secretary of State website, that WMS & Associcates LLC was involvuntary desolved on 4/8/2022.  Bob subsequently continued to use the WMS & Associates LLC company name under which my agreement was finalized.  The total charge for his services was quoted at $5000 of which I only paid halk $2500 up front.  The remaining balance of $2500 was not paid.  I have since been ghosted by Bob as he has not returned emails, text or phone call to his number 630-605-2088.  This clearly was an attempt to fraud and a scam to collect fees.
I was contracted as an independent contractor for a order fulfillment associate, however I was never paid for the services and now all dashboard , and emails and phone numbers aren’t responding

This person posted a video on tik tok showing an apartment unit in the neighborhood and then when you inquire they set up a tour date but before then you have to fill out a brief questionnaire/application and then it asks for a deposit you will get back after viewing the apartment whether you are interested or not you will get it back they reassure you that and say it will be used to defer people from seeing it that are not serious or might miss the assigned time, they then said oh your payment wasn’t received after sending confirmation and then say they have many applications as that is what’s taking time because they cannot refund it unless it is allegedly confirmed

Product has been sent to me and I’m allergic to the main ingredient… iodine.
Tried contacting them and there is no way to reach them and they keep sending them.Calling my bank.
Repeated spam phone calls claiming approval of a low interest 50,000-90,000 loan.

They charged me an additional $1020 (on top of the agreed upon total) for travel time to move my belongings. We live far away from a big city. They did not tell us they were booking movers from three hours away (6-hours of travel in total). If we had known we definitely would not have used their service. The travel fee in the original agreement was $25. They said nothing about the additional travel expense. They tacked that amount on at the very end and the movers would not unload our belongings until we paid the full amount.
I got an email saying I borrowed money from Cash Net and I owe 1999.00.  I never borrowed money from cash net.  They threatened me with a lawsuit.
Cashmere sweater advertised on Facebook. Took weeks to arrive. Clearly not cashmere and no tags at all. Company did not provide return information.

Mail from "Home Warranty Division" uses alarming language as "important to contact..to avoid unnecessary delays...need to get home warranty up to day...final notice...failure to call...revoke your eligibility...after expiration date." Not illegal but alarming and easily sounds as if you are lacking or have let coverage expire. I called to get removed from their mailing list, the man on the line kept asking questions about coverage and would not relent after telling him I just want to be removed from list. I asked several times and said I just want my addressed removed and he would not stop. I said I would call the BBB and he asked what company I would report on? and he hung up. Sounds like "Home Warranty Division" is just a generic name.

Found the job advertised on a job board, flexjobs. They reached out stating they were interested in talking. However, no interview was set up. Instead they just sent an email saying to expect a check. I never accepted any job offer. I told them via email I had no interest. Instead they sent me two checks to cash for about $1000 each. I shredded both. In that mailing they claimed they're sending product next. This needs to stop fast.
